stem.text: An object shaped as a hemisphere rests with its flat surface on a table. The object has radius $r$ and density $\rho$.

stem.alt: Hemisphere resting with its flat face on a horizontal table, with radius r marked from the centre to the curved surface.

stem.text: The volume of a sphere is $\dfrac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}$.
Which average pressure does the object exert on the table?
